item.title: Trucking bankruptcies surge as diesel shortage and oil price warnings persist
item.description: At least 16 U.S. trucking, delivery and transportation companies filed for bankruptcy protection between late August and Sept. 21, according to federal court filings and carrier records reviewed by FreightWaves, as carriers grapple with rising diesel fuel prices and other elevated operating costs.…
